title: Composer Quick Actions Drawer
scope: D288-D291 and D308 Open WebUI-style composer plus menu, ready action, adaptive free/local route strip and click fixture
principle: The first chat surface keeps one calm plus button while useful free chat routes, model, node, knowledge, voice, settings and reset actions stay one click away.
public_repo_rule: Public-safe UI evidence only. No prompts, responses, cookies, provider keys, pairing tokens, billing data or private node telemetry.

controls.expected: Opens a compact tools drawer after deferred assets load; before that it still falls back to the model picker.
Shows the current selected model, route/device summary and no-paid-route boundary before the action buttons.
Starts the safest free chat route immediately and seeds a useful prompt only when the composer is empty.
evidence: Start the safest free MMIR chat now.

controls.expected: Shows direct no-spend route choices for MMIR Guide, Browser WebGPU and local route state, switching from Qwen3 install to Local ready when Local Node reports a model.

A dependency-free DOM fixture clicks Guide, Browser WebGPU, Local install and live Local ready route chips and proves starter handoff, prompt seeding, send click, installer resume and no-spend boundaries.
evidence: Composer quick route fixture smoke check passed.

controls.expected: Opens the compact model picker with free, browser, live and local routes first.
Starts the no-spend local node installer handoff with a browser-local repair resume.
Opens the local-first Knowledge panel without sending files to a public frontend backend.
Starts a fresh local conversation through the existing New chat or Clear path.
Opens browser-local voice tools or local runtime settings from the same compact drawer.

completion_rule: The plus menu is beta-complete when source smoke gates prove every drawer action and free route chip has a real no-spend handler and the first-paint performance budget stays green.
